name: @insolvia-ai/contract
//: The backend's HTTP contract suite (ADR 0028, plan 18.2) — a base-URL
suite, never published. It runs the SHIPPED api-client against a running
stack, which is why @insolvia-ai/api-client is a workspace dependency
rather than a copy: a client/server disagreement must fail here.
`test` needs a running stack and the CONTRACT_* variables
.NET stack and supplies them, which is why `test` is NOT `jest`
under the root's fan-out: a bare `npm test` at the root must not fail
for want of a backend. Run `npm run contract --workspace
@insolvia-ai/contract` from the script, or the script itself.
